alt: A flowchart of the Centering algorithm from Start to End: 1 identify the forward-looking centers (Cf) of the current utterance, ranked by prominence; 2 determine the preferred center (Cp), usually the subject; 3 determine the backward-looking center (Cb) from the previous utterance; 4 apply the transition type (Continue, Retain or Shift); 5 prefer antecedents that keep the continuity and prominence of centers.
author: Apurva Jadhav

alt: A handwritten syntactic tree for the sentence John saw Mary, he greeted her. The root S has John (noun) and saw (verb) below it, and under saw sit Mary (noun) and he (pronoun) with the following words greeted and her. It is the teacher's sketch for the Hobbs example, where the nouns above the pronoun he are searched.
author: Apurva Jadhav
